big tee ruas detected upon hir exomineton. He war initable and being in, pain, as weu

acd Oxycadone, 5mg at bad tire wae procibed. He was adviced to stik to shealthier
life stylen
Do week later, the proviaulf requated invertigatons vevealed mion elepersrative chinger
I the left tint metataxepholacgealjoint. High level of urate, CRD ocd MIH were
